subject: Sizzle reel — short clip + badge usage request
messages:
From: Ellen Park <ellen@edgenet.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — 30s clip + Redwood badge for our Q3 sizzle reel

Hi Jonas / Marissa,

Hope youre well. Were putting together a short sizzle reel for EdgeNets Q3 product launch and would love to include a 2030 second clip from the demo you did last month, plus a small Redwood badge on the partner slide.

What we need from you to move forward:
- Written permission to use the clip and Redwood logo/badge for marketing (web, social, event loop) for 12 months
- A short one-sentence attribution (company + title) and a logo file in PNG/SVG
- Any constraints on edits or quote tone

Attached is a first-pass script and a still of the proposed badge placement. Happy to sign whatever release you prefer.

Attachments: draft_sizzle_script_v1.pdf

Best,
Ellen Park
Marketing Lead, EdgeNet
ellen@edgenet.io
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@edgenet.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 30s clip + Redwood badge for our Q3 sizzle reel

Thanks Ellen f4 for the ask and for the script. Quick clarifying questions before legal/comms review:
- Intended usage window: you mentioned Q3 — can you confirm exact dates (start/end)?
- Distribution channels: website hero, paid social, trade show loop?
- Will the clip include customer logos/PII beyond the badge?

Ill loop in our legal and comms teams for the formal release. Ive attached a very small usage outline to speed review. If you have a DocuSign envelope ready thats fine too.

Attachments: usage_outline.xlsx

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com

From: Ellen Park <ellen@edgenet.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 30s clip + Redwood badge for our Q3 sizzle reel

Thanks Jonas  were targeting 2027-07-01 through 2028-06-30 (12 months). Channels: web hero, organic + paid social (short spots), and event loop at partner booths. No customer PII in the clip; its product b-roll and a short onscreen demo with a voiceover.

Ive created a DocuSign marketing release for convenience: https://www.docusign.net/envelope/12345-ENVELOPE (envelope ID included in metadata). Also attaching a preview of the badge placement.

Attachments: logo_badge_preview.png

Let me know if you want any changes; happy to revise.

Best,
Ellen

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ellen Park <ellen@edgenet.io>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 30s clip + Redwood badge for our Q3 sizzle reel

Jonas / Marissa,

I reviewed the DocuSign draft and the usage outline. We can grant permission with the following standard carve-outs (see attached redline):
- Permission limited to the stated channels and the explicit 12-month window.
- No edits that change the meaning of Redwood quotes or attribute a position we didnt approve.
- Redwood logo must be used per our brand guidelines (no color swaps, minimum clear space).
- We require a sign-off copy of the final cut at least 5 business days prior to public distribution.
- If EdgeNet requests extension beyond 12 months, submit formal request 30 days before expiry.

Please review the redline and confirm if Ellen will accept. If so, well sign and return a PDF.

Attachments: release_redline_v1.pdf

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen@edgenet.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick ask — 30s clip + Redwood badge for our Q3 sizzle reel

Hi Ellen  thanks for the fast turnaround. Per legals redline, Redwood grants permission for the 2030s clip and the badge on the partner slide for the window 2027-07-01 to 2028-06-30, subject to the constraints Laura outlined (brand usage, final-cut sign-off, no misleading edits).

Next steps from our side:
- Well sign the redlined release and return a scanned PDF (attached).
- Please confirm the final cut length and the exact frame where the badge will appear so our design team can pre-check the asset.
- Provide the DocuSign envelope confirmation once signed on your side so we can reconcile.

Attachments: signed_marketing_release.pdf

If all good, consider this a greenlight pending the routine sign-off. Looking forward to seeing the final sizzle.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Head of Comms, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
